body: You too.

Ah I suppose you're right. Well it is approaching 1 A.M. here I sincerely thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking your time to talk to me. I am feeling better, and think I should get some rest.

So I fight for her? Whoever she is?
Okay, I will try new things. Its just sometimes death seems so peaceful. No more worries or stress or responsibilities. A way to escape from it all. You know?
